create_timestep: create a dm_env.TimeStep spec with observation spec, step type, discount, and reward fields
create_rgb_observation: create an RGB observation spec with given height, width, and optional name
create_world_rgb_observation: create a WORLD.RGB observation spec from an ascii map and sprite size
create_action_spec: create a discrete action spec with a given number of possible actions
create_inventory_spec: create an INVENTORY observation spec with a given number of resource types
